import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.exporter import export_rows
from src.csv_exporter import export_csv
from src.json_exporter import export_json
from src.dispatcher import export

rows = [
    {"id": 1, "name": "Ann, \"A\"", "extra": "x"},
    {"id": None},
    {"name": "Zoë\nline"},
    {"id": 0, "name": False},
]
snapshot = [dict(r) for r in rows]
assert export_csv(rows) == 'id,name\n1,"Ann, ""A"""\n,\n,"Zoë\nline"\n0,False\n'
assert export_json(rows) == '[{"id":"1","name":"Ann, \\"A\\""},{"id":"","name":""},{"id":"","name":"Zoë\\nline"},{"id":"0","name":"False"}]'
assert rows == snapshot, "inputs mutated"
for fmt in ("csv", "json"):
    assert export_rows(rows, fmt) == export(rows, fmt)
    assert export_rows(iter(rows), fmt) == export_rows(rows, fmt)
    assert export_rows((r for r in rows), fmt) == export_rows(rows, fmt)
assert export_csv([]) == "id,name\n" and export_json(iter([])) == "[]"
for bad in ("xml", "CSV", None, ["csv"]):
    try:
        export_rows(rows, bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(bad)
    try:
        export(rows, bad)
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError(bad)
# wrappers delegate to the shared entry point
import src.exporter as ex
calls = []
orig = ex.export_rows
import src.csv_exporter as c, src.json_exporter as j
c.export_rows = j.export_rows = lambda r, f: calls.append(f) or orig(r, f)
export_csv([]); export_json([])
assert calls == ["csv", "json"]
print("ok")
